identity.scope: fixed point-observation identity; caller also binds code, control, parameters and branch

scope: fixed 4x5 state, four interior dBZ points per three times, diagonal std/quality, exogenous grid background; no optimized response

support.branch_policy: pointwise strict minmod; caller pins expected_branch for endpoint comparison
support.coordinate_convention: fixed (row, column) cell-center indices; strict interior 2x2 stencils
support.initial_background: fixed exogenous state-grid field + theta * fixed pattern
support.observation_errors: independent diagonal std/quality in point-observation space
support.observation_masks: all valid and detected; missing/censored/QC unsupported
support.observation_units: dBZ point value; interpolate dBZ after state echo-to-dBZ conversion
